title: invoice.events
description: An invoice (deposit, withdrawal, refund) on creation and on every status change, on the player events exchange (PAM_EXCHANGE, default pam.events). Only `type` CREDIT with `status` SUCCESS and a positive `amount` is acted on. The envelope's `playerId` must be a positive JSON integer (never quoted, never fractional) equal to `data.player.id`; JSON Schema cannot express that equality, the consumer checks it and dead-letters a mismatch. Unknown fields anywhere are ignored.

playerId.description: The player the fact is about; equals `data.player.id`.

id.description: The invoice id; the idempotency key is invoice:<id>.

type.description: CREDIT (a deposit) is acted on; any other string (PAYOUT, REFUND, a value added later) is acknowledged without effect. Never a number or null.

status.description: SUCCESS (the money landed) is acted on; any other string (PENDING, PROCESSING, REJECTED, a value added later) is acknowledged without effect. Never a number or null.

amount.description: Signed int64 nano units (1e-9) of `currency`. Only a positive amount counts.

currency.description: Currency code of `amount`. Anything but PARTNER_CURRENCY is converted by Currency-Exchange-Service; one it does not know dead-letters the fact.

updatedAt.description: When the invoice reached this status; its UTC day is the day the deposit counts on.

affiliateTag.description: The affiliate tag the brand site stored from `?affiliate=`. The company's identity itself, with no prefix, read in any letter case: every tag is looked up among the companies, and one that names no company, null or absence is acknowledged without effect.

affiliateAttribution.description: Free-form attribution keys the brand site stored at sign-up, string values only. `click_id` is passed to the partner's tracker when it matches ^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{1,128}$; the whole object is kept on the referral. Absent, null or {} when there are none.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, any letter case. Anything that is not two letters is stored as unknown.

createdAt.description: When the player registered: the referral's registration time and the UTC day it counts on.

player.description: The invoice's owner as of the invoice. Used to attribute the player when this deposit is handled before the player's register.events.
